reason: The card statement part sounds useful since I already check my KTC bill every month, but the slip capture needs an iPhone Shortcut set up before it works, and I do not want to fight with a setup on my phone when I only have one evening a week to sort my money out. I would use the free trial to look at it, then probably stop.
objection: If the Shortcut setup takes me more than a few minutes, or breaks after an iOS update, I will just go back to typing things in by hand.
would_change_my_mind: If the card statement import reads my real KTC PDF correctly the first time and the slip capture works on my first try with no fiddling.
